notes:
Security and reliability fixes from a whole-system audit.

- Family profiles are visible only inside your family or a live wishlist share
- A failed sync no longer hides data or reports a false success
- PIN unlock uses a stronger hash; stay-signed-in saves or forgets the password when you toggle it
- Update downloads are HTTPS-only and digest-verified
- A canceled claim no longer blocks the wish, and secret gifts stay secret
